recipes.name: Creamy Avocado Dip
instructions: Add all ingredients to a small food processor and blend until creamy*. Mix, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based yogurt that is fortified with calcium . * If you don't have a small food processor, simply mash the avocado in a bowl first, add in the crushed garlic, and the remaining ingredients.
Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. Can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day.
